gloss: competitive; hating to lose; determined not to be beaten

definitions.explanation: A personality trait characterized by refusing to give up and striving to win or succeed. Generally seen as a positive quality in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{負|ま}けず{嫌|ぎら}いな{性格|せいかく}だ。
{負|ま}けず{嫌|ぎら}いだから{絶対|ぜったい}に{諦|あきら}めない。
examples.english: Because I hate losing, I never give up.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{負|ま}けず{嫌|ぎら}いだった。
examples.english: I've been competitive since I was a child.

notes:
FORMATION:
{負|ま}けず (not losing, from {負|ま}ける) + {嫌|ぎら}い (dislike)

Literally 'disliking not winning' → 'hating to lose.'

ADJECTIVE USAGE:
{負|ま}けず{嫌|ぎら}いな + noun
・{負|ま}けず{嫌|ぎら}いな{人|ひと} - competitive person
・{負|ま}けず{嫌|ぎら}いな{性格|せいかく} - competitive personality

CULTURAL NOTE:
This is generally viewed positively in Japanese culture, suggesting determination and perseverance. It's often used to describe successful athletes, businesspeople, and students.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{勝|か}ち{気|き} - competitive spirit
・{負|まけ}ん{気|き} - fighting spirit (dialect/casual)
